dry_run.description: If true (default), return candidates without writing. Pair with yes=true to actually write.

min_confidence.description: Minimum memory confidence for promotion (default 0.7 for procedural, 0.8 for semantic).

project_dir.description: Absolute path to the project root where .claude/rules/ should be created. Defaults to process.cwd().

target.description: Promotion target. Only claude-rules is implemented in PR 4 v1.

yes.description: Confirm write. Without this or dry_run=false the command stays in dry-run mode.
